description: Get a 6-hour session token for an app user without email. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <session_token> to https://reqres.in/app/collections/{collection}/records, where the user only sees their own records. Real users sign in with an emailed code via /api/app-users/login.

api_key.description: Project manage key (pro_...) returned by create_project. Public keys (pub_...) are read-only.

name: create_app_user_session
title: Sign in as an app user
